I don't have a way to save notes between conversations, so I can't promise I'll remember this on my own. What I can do: your message stays here in our DM, and I can look it up if you ask me later.

If you want it written down somewhere more reliable, I can put the call on your calendar for Thursday at 16:30. I can only create one meeting at a time, not a weekly repeat, so I'd add them one by one. Just tell me which weeks you want and whether to invite anyone else.
